content.text: This is really common at 5, and it usually sticks because it works every time. Tonight, tell him the new rule at bedtime: "If you wake up, you stay in your bed, and I'll walk you back." Then, if he turns up, walk him back quietly and calmly each time, with no chat and no negotiating. The first few nights are the hardest, so it helps if you and your partner do it the same way.
